verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software product, so operating it with natural-language commands is the wrong axis for this kind of offering. Its only digital resources in the evidence are an investor-readiness questionnaire, downloadable cap tables and a UPC decision tracker, and none of these is described as taking natural-language commands. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so there is no agent-facing surface that would make the axis apply.
